findings.text: performance lens, medium: On resume, the dispatch-unit loop calls `get_state_field` (which forks a subshell, then forks `validate_json`/jq, then forks jq again to read the value — three processes) once per stage/cycle iteration; reading all stage statuses into an associative array once before the loop would eliminate O(N) process forks. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3730; fix: code)

performance lens, medium: The cycle:* arm of the dispatch-unit loop also calls `get_state_field` per cycle on every resume, adding the same three-process-fork overhead for each cycle unit; both arms should read stage statuses from a single pre-loop bulk read. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3444; fix: code)
